calibration_window: synthetic (fitted-posterior bounds, not a real window)
known_invalid_uses: Do not use synthetic-only test slices to claim real-world reliability; they measure generator agreement, not sim-to-real transfer (doc D).
Do not feed `origin` / scenario metadata as default model features; it lets the model learn generator identity instead of dynamics (doc D).
Do not treat teacher-forced realized futures as action-conditioned targets — always use the paired counterfactual deltas (doc R).
Do not zero-fill missing telemetry; missingness is first-class state.
